transformations.name: fildelis_ny_bh_test_IngestFilter
transformations.condition: batch_id_src_1 = max_batch_id AND (corrupt_record_src_1 IS NULL OR corrupt_record_src_1 = '')

derived_fields.name: care_management_program
derived_fields.expression: CONCAT_WS('|', harp_eligible_src_1, health_homes_enrolled_src_1, health_home_status_src_1, CAST(health_home_start_date_src_1 AS STRING), health_homes_plus_eligible_src_1, high_need_status_src_1, in_care_management_with_fidelis_src_1)

derived_fields.name: is_zip4
derived_fields.expression: CASE WHEN zip4 IS NOT NULL THEN 'true' ELSE 'false' END
